proof_scope: record-failure and inspect exercised through the real skill run.sh, with independent readback of the written replay ledger artifact

claims.proves: pipeline-self-repair records a required pipeline-step failure as a blocking replay-ledger event with triage, stable category, and ticket disposition; the ledger can be folded for checkpoint gating.
claims.does_not_prove: live GitHub mutation, project-watchdog dispatch, memory daemon availability, or paid provider/Kling side effects. Those require explicit --apply-ticket/--dispatch-watchdog/live provider runs.

capability_claims.description: record-failure writes an append-only blocking step.failed ledger event with triage, category_key, failure_category_id, and ticket disposition.
inspect folds the ledger into open blocking failure state for checkpoint-resume gating.
record-failure fails closed instead of inventing a failure when no raw signal or receipt is supplied.

failure_modes: ledger writes but cannot be read back
blocking failure is hidden from resume gate
missing failure evidence produces a fake category

cases.name: record_failure_dry_run_writes_replay_ledger
command:
set -euo pipefail; TMP=/tmp/pipeline-self-repair-agentic-eval; rm -rf "$TMP"; mkdir -p "$TMP"; ../run.sh record-failure --pipeline persona-dream --step-id phase_11_kling_submit --run-id eval-run --raw-signal 'multi_prompt prompt exceeds 512 characters' --layer kling --target skills/persona-dream --run-root "$TMP" --ledger "$TMP/replay_ledger.jsonl" --skip-memory --skip-github --no-ticket --json > "$TMP/record.json"; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
root='/tmp/pipeline-self-repair-agentic-eval'
record=json.load(open(root+'/record.json'))
line=json.loads(open(root+'/replay_ledger.jsonl').read().strip())
assert record['event']['event_hash'] == line['event_hash']
assert line['blocking'] is True
assert line['ticket']['action'] == 'ticket_skipped'
print('PIPELINE_SELF_REPAIR_LEDGER_OK')
PY

cases.name: inspect_reports_open_failure_from_replay_ledger
command:
set -euo pipefail; TMP=/tmp/pipeline-self-repair-agentic-eval-inspect; rm -rf "$TMP"; mkdir -p "$TMP"; ../run.sh record-failure --pipeline monitor-opportunities --step-id nightly_publish --run-id eval-inspect --raw-signal 'nightly_revision_mismatch expected abc got def' --layer monitor-opportunities --target skills/monitor-opportunities --run-root "$TMP" --ledger "$TMP/replay_ledger.jsonl" --skip-memory --skip-github --no-ticket --json >/dev/null; ../run.sh inspect --ledger "$TMP/replay_ledger.jsonl" --json > "$TMP/inspect.json"; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
root='/tmp/pipeline-self-repair-agentic-eval-inspect'
summary=json.load(open(root+'/inspect.json'))
assert summary['open_failure_count'] == 1, summary
print('PIPELINE_SELF_REPAIR_INSPECT_OK')
PY
